<awtsmoosMeluketTranslation heichel="ikar" alias="meluket_translation_en" seriesId="חשון_meluket" postId="BH_POST_1766518914964_theRebbe_974" batchId="meluket-_D7_97_D7_A9_D7_95_D7_9F_meluket__BH_POST_1766518914964_theRebbe_974__p003">
  <section v="6">
    <sectionSummaryBrief>This section explains that Sarah represents Malchus, and through the drawing of the Sefiros into Malchus, they are elevated by the revelation from the root of Malchus in Arich Anpin, resulting in their unification and the absence of division in "the years of the life of Sarah."</sectionSummaryBrief>
    <t s="0">The explanation is,</t>
    <t s="1">as is explained in the maamar,</t>
    <t s="2">that Sarah is the aspect of Malchus</t>
    <t s="3">[therefore she is called Sarah, from the term of rulership]</t>
    <t s="4">and "the years of life" are the Sefiros that are above Malchus.</t>
    <t s="5">And according to the known principle</t>
    <t s="6">(and also explained in the aforementioned maamar)</t>
    <t s="7">that the root of Malchus is above the root of all the Sefiros,</t>
    <t s="8">for the root of all the Sefiros is in Arich Anpin and the root of Malchus is in Radla,</t>
    <t s="9">it can be said,</t>
    <t s="10">that through the drawing of the Sefiros into Malchus,</t>
    <t s="11">and in a manner that they become unified with Malchus to the extent that "they are her life,"</t>
    <t s="12">an elevation occurs in the Sefiros,</t>
    <t s="13">such that a semblance of the revelation of Radla</t>
    <t s="14">(the root of Malchus) is drawn into them.</t>
    <t s="15">And through this,</t>
    <t s="16">they are all included and unified as one,</t>
    <t s="17">all equal.</t>
    <t s="18">And this is that regarding "And the life of Sarah was" it says "one hundred years and twenty years and seven years,"</t>
    <t s="19">but in "the years of the life of Sarah" it does not specify the numbers of one hundred, twenty, and seven,</t>
    <t s="20">for the "years of life"</t>
    <t s="21">(the Sefiros)</t>
    <t s="22">as they are in their own right,</t>
    <t s="23">including also as they are drawn into Malchus but in a way that the "years of life" and Malchus are two separate matters</t>
    <t s="24">("she merited the years of life"),</t>
    <t s="25">are in a state of division,</t>
    <t s="26">and in general are divided into three aspects</t>
    <t s="27">(one hundred,</t>
    <t s="28">twenty, and seven),</t>
    <t s="29">but when they become the matter of Malchus</t>
    <t s="30">[that is, "the years of the life of Sarah,"</t>
    <t s="31">"they are her life"],</t>
    <t s="32">the revelation of the root of Malchus, which is above division, shines within them.</t>
  </section>
  <section v="7">
    <sectionSummaryBrief>This section adds that the negation of division in "the years of the life of Sarah" is twofold: they are not divided into the three categories, and they are even above the division of details within a general number.</sectionSummaryBrief>
    <t s="0">5)</t>
    <t s="1">And one may add,</t>
    <t s="2">that the negation of division in "the years of the life of Sarah" is in two matters.</t>
    <t s="3">That they are not divided into the three divisions of one hundred, twenty, and seven,</t>
    <t s="4">as in the previous section 4.</t>
    <t s="5">And furthermore,</t>
    <t s="6">even within the three divisions of one hundred, twenty, and seven,</t>
    <t s="7">although each one is a general matter,</t>
    <t s="8">nevertheless,</t>
    <t s="9">since the general is in a specific number</t>
    <t s="10">(one hundred,</t>
    <t s="11">twenty,</t>
    <t s="12">seven)</t>
    <t s="13">it therefore contains</t>
    <t s="14">(at least in a concealed way)</t>
    <t s="15">divided details.</t>
    <t s="16">And the reason that in "the years of the life of Sarah" no number is stated</t>
    <t s="17">(not even the number one hundred and twenty and seven,</t>
    <t s="18">which is not divided into three divisions)</t>
    <t s="19">is,</t>
    <t s="20">because they are above even the matter of the division of details as they are included in the general.</t>
  </section>
  <section v="8">
    <sectionSummaryBrief>This section elaborates that "one hundred years" corresponds to Kesser (Arich Anpin) including all ten Sefiros, "twenty years" to Chochmah and Binah, and "seven years" to the seven emotive attributes, and explains that the superiority of "the years of the life of Sarah" is that they are above even the level of "one hundred years" in the singular, which is from the revelation of Atik.</sectionSummaryBrief>
    <t s="0">And the explanation of the matter in more detail,</t>
    <t s="1">will be understood by prefacing what is explained in many places,</t>
    <t s="2">that "one hundred years" is Kesser</t>
    <t s="3">(Arich Anpin)</t>
    <t s="4">which includes all ten Sefiros as they are in their most perfect state,</t>
    <t s="5">for each one is comprised of ten,</t>
    <t s="6">[totaling] one hundred.</t>
    <t s="7">And regarding the reason it is stated</t>
    <t s="8">(one hundred)</t>
    <t s="9">"year" in the singular,</t>
    <t s="10">there are two explanations.</t>
    <t s="11">For the division of the Sefiros</t>
    <t s="12">(Chochmah,</t>
    <t s="13">Binah, etc.)</t>
    <t s="14">is in the revealed Sefiros, unlike when they are included in their root</t>
    <t s="15">(Arich Anpin)</t>
    <t s="16">where they are all included as one.</t>
    <t s="17">And furthermore,</t>
    <t s="18">the aspect of Atik is not within the category of ten Sefiros</t>
    <t s="19">(meaning it is not even a source for the ten Sefiros),</t>
    <t s="20">and through the revelation of Atik that shines in Arich Anpin,</t>
    <t s="21">even the Sefiros included in Arich Anpin,</t>
    <t s="22">[the] one hundred,</t>
    <t s="23">are in the aspect of "year" in the singular.</t>
    <t s="24">"Twenty years" are Chochmah and Binah, each of which is comprised of ten.</t>
    <t s="25">And regarding them as well, "year" is stated in the singular,</t>
    <t s="26">for Chochmah and Binah are</t>
    <t s="27">"two companions that never separate."</t>
    <t s="28">And "seven years" are the seven emotive attributes.</t>
    <t s="29">And "seven years" is stated in the plural,</t>
    <t s="30">for the emotive attributes are in a state of division.</t>
    <t s="31">And based on this, the superiority of "the years of the life of Sarah," in which no number is stated, will be understood even more,</t>
    <t s="32">for they are above even "one hundred years" in the singular,</t>
    <t s="33">even according to the explanation that "one hundred years" in the singular is due to the revelation of Atik.</t>
  </section>
</awtsmoosMeluketTranslation>
